en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a richly decorated stone building in a hilly, wooded setting. The structure has Romanesque‑revival features, including a large round arch portal with sculpted reliefs, flanked by two cylindrical corner towers with conical roofs. There is a symmetrical stairway leading up to a small monument or altar with a wreath laid in front, suggesting a memorial. A wrought‑iron fence runs along the foreground, and other urban buildings are visible to the left.
